entries.reason: The harness requires a pre-version-bump Git fixture, while release preflight may invoke the auto-runner after a version bump; its explicit portability owner runs the isolated fixture in the correct lifecycle state.

The concurrent-rewrite subtest is a live timing probe (writer process vs consecutive full-manifest scans); under the parallel gate-meta snapshot the box is oversubscribed and scan phases can slide past even a stop-file-protocol writer, so temporal isolation is a validity requirement, not an optimization (2026-07-29 release-9/10 + PR18r2 + PR19r5 anchors).
The portability suite explicitly owns this classifier-only regression so it cannot be confused with or expanded into the guarded entrypoint's external provider mode.
